Questions to confirm before hiring

The following are buyer-verification questions, not claims that the provider has agreed to these terms.

  • Confirm the contracting business name shown on the quote and invoice.
  • Ask which changeover, carpet-cleaning or exterior-cleaning tasks belong in the initial scope.
  • Confirm the property address, linen plan and how additional work is priced before scheduling.

Planning cleaning & turnovers for your rental

Ask whether this location handles vacation-rental turnovers, linen coordination and arrival-day deadlines. General house cleaning does not establish turnover availability.

Confirm the exact property address, requested service and current availability directly. A published city or service area is not an office address or a guarantee that every property is accepted.

Before you hire

  1. Do you support same-day turnovers and holiday arrivals?
  2. What does the checklist cover, and do you send timestamped completion photos?
  3. Who handles linen replacement, supply restocking and damage reporting?

Ask for a written scope, itemized pricing, recent relevant references and confirmation that the vendor serves your exact address.
